raw_site_text: 85 municipalities in 17 states: Chiapas, Chihuahua, Durango, Guanajuato, Guerrero, Hidago, Jalisco, Estado de Mexico, Michoacan, Morelos, Oaxaca, Puebla, San Luis Potosi, Tamaulipas, Veracruz, Yucatan, Zacatecas
justification: Footnote 5 lists the 17 states in which audits were conducted (5 municipalities per state).
note: Mexico City explicitly excluded from the sampling frame; 'Estado de Mexico' mapped to 'Mexico'.
